Bill.BriefDescription: Making adjustments to the unemployment insurance system.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to making adjustments in the unemployment insurancesystem to enhance benefit and tax equity; and creating a new section.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BillSection.RCWSLText: The legislature finds that it is in the bestinterest of unemployed workers, businesses, and the state to maintaina stable and solvent unemployment insurance system. The legislatureintends to make adjustments to benefit and tax equity that ensure boththe stability and solvency of the system.
